integrity.code_reproducibility: Python standard library; verify.py; exact sign predicates and full finite chamber certification
integrity.proof_type: exact algebraic chamber enumeration combined with spherical Gauss-Bonnet

scientific_limitations: Applies to a shared uniformly distributed central-plane normal for the specified aligned regular dodecahedron and icosahedron; excludes vertex-incident orientations, noncentral sections, independent rotations and deformed bodies.

The ten-circle dodecahedral spherical tessellation and one-body icosahedral central-section distribution are previous work. The proposed addition is the joint incidence/refinement and four-state coupled distribution.
Historical diagrams of the sixteen-circle subarrangement may encode related incidence implicitly; priority is not independently established.
title: Joint central-section law and a rigid icosahedral refinement of dodecahedral normal chambers
